# @forge-dashboard/sdk-node

> Node/TypeScript client for forge-dashboard's REST API, generated from its
> OpenAPI spec with openapi-typescript and openapi-fetch. Every operation is
> a typed `client.GET(path, ...)` / `client.POST(path, ...)` call returning
> `{ data, error, response }`, with automatic retry on 429/5xx.

Requires Node.js 20+ or Bun 1.1+, a running forge-dashboard instance, and a
personal API token for every endpoint except `/healthz` and `/api/version`.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-node/): full typedoc-generated reference, built from the source's TSDoc comments.
- [createForgeDashboardClient](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-node/functions/createForgeDashboardClient.html): builds the typed client, taking the base URL and an optional token/retry/fetch config.
- [decodeError](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-node/functions/decodeError.html): turns a failed response into a uniform ApiError.
- [ApiError](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-node/classes/ApiError.html): the error type every failed call decodes to.
- [ClientOptions](https://alrayyes.github.io/forge-dashboard-sdk-node/interfaces/ClientOptions.html): the options object createForgeDashboardClient accepts (token, retry, fetch).

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/forge-dashboard-sdk-node): source, issues, and CONTRIBUTING.md for building, testing and the release process.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forge-dashboard/sdk-node): install and version history.
